title: feat: add Users, Roles, and Change Password frontend pages
body: ## Summary Adds three new frontend pages wired into routing and sidebar navigation, integrating the existing Users, Roles, and Change Password backend APIs. ### New pages - **UsersPage** (`/users`, admin-only) — Table of users with Create/Edit/Delete. Modal form with name, username, password, and role dropdown (populated from `/api/roles`). Handles 409 on self-delete. - **RolesPage** (`/roles`, admin-only) — Table of roles with Create/Edit/Delete. Edit modal only allows description changes (matching backend `RoleUpdate` model). Handles 409 when role still has assigned users. - **ChangePasswordPage** (`/change-password`, all authenticated users) — Card-based form with current/new/confirm password fields. Client-side match validation. Calls `PUT /api/auth/me/password`. ### Routing & navigation changes - **App.jsx** — Added three `` entries; Users and Roles wrapped in ``, Change Password open to all authenticated users. - **Layout.jsx** — Added Users and Roles to `navItems` (admin-only). Added a `KeyRound` icon button in the user footer section linking to `/change-password` (available to all roles). All pages follow the existing TemplatesPage patterns: axios via `api.js`, `react-hot-toast` notifications, Tailwind utility classes, `lucide-react` icons, and the modal overlay pattern. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Log in as `admin/admin123` and verify Users page loads at `/users` with the list of existing users - [ ] Create, edit, and delete a user on the Users page; confirm toasts appear and the table updates - [ ] Verify the Roles page at `/roles` — create a role, edit its description, attempt to delete a role with assigned users (expect 409 error toast) - [ ] Log in as a non-admin (e.g. `staff/staff123`) and confirm Users/Roles nav items are hidden, but the Change Password key icon is visible - [ ] Change password via `/change-password` — verify success toast and that login works with the new password ### Notes - Build verified locally (`npm run build` passes with no errors). - All three pages are purely additive — no existing code was refactored. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/9396f01086b646aaa1f2737c76227035 Requested by: @danrocks ---
